correctness.rationale: In J=Kt+Kt^2+Kt^3 with sigma(a)=a^q, m>=2, direct Ore multiplication gives commutation iff a sigma(A)=A sigma(a) and a sigma(B)+b sigma²(A)=A sigma(b)+B sigma²(a). When a!=0, A/a lies in F_q and B=ub+v a sigma(a), v in F_q, giving the entire commutative associative centralizer H(a,b) of size q²Q. J² is a maximal commuting clique because sigma is nontrivial. Distinct H are parametrized by projective [a] and b modulo F_q a^{q+1}. Intersections governed by [a] to [a^{q+1}], with kernel gcd((Q-1)/(q-1),q+1) = 1 odd m, q+1 even m. First-coefficient-zero centralizer spectrum follows the sigma² norm equation; double counting all commuting pairs yields Q³[(q²+q+1)Q-q(q+1)]. The algebra group 1+J preserves commutation. Independent GF4 quotient arithmetic yielded centralizer sizes 16 (56 elements) and 64 (8 elements), 1408 ordered commuting pairs, seven maximal commuting classes, agreeing with the formulas. Small computations corroborate, not certify, all q,m.
